results.statement: For A=D+U Lambda U^T+E and a nonzero original scalar pivot, let N be the exact normalized rank-two Schur carrier, delta its pair-law disjointness, and epsilon_z=||E||F(1+2||U_-Lambda u||/|a|)+||E||F^2/|a|. If s2(N)>=24 epsilon_z/sqrt(delta), then ||p_Q||inf<=44.288410066 delta^(-1/8)[(1-c)|a d det Lambda|]^(-1/4) using the ACTUAL Schur cross block. Otherwise partner r34 forces one physical coloop or three physical carrier coordinates at scale (epsilon_z/s2(N))^(1/3).

If max original rank-two leverage<=1/3, then delta>=1/512. Hence either ||p_Q||inf<=96.593707287[(1-c)|a d det Lambda|]^(-1/4), or the exact Schur matrix is D'+R1+E' with rank R1<=1, E' symmetric zero-diagonal, and ||E'||F<544.058007952 epsilon_z.

For physical M=A[I,J], additional physical column bank C=A[I,T], P the top-two left singular projection of M, and t1>=t2>=t3 singular values of (I-P)C, every slab ratio rho obeys s1(M)s2(M)t1t2t3 <=(5sqrt(2e)/rho)^5; hence t3 <=(5sqrt(2e)/rho)^(5/3)[s1(M)s2(M)]^(-1/3). No marginal gate.
